A combination of drospirenone 3 mg with ethinylestradiol 20 micrograms, given daily for 24 days of each 28-day cycle, may also be used for contra- ception and for the management of premenstrual dys- phoric disorder (see below) or moderate acne (p.1577) in women who also require an oral contraceptive. Dro- spirenone is also used as the progestogenic component of menopausal HRT (see below) in a continuous dos- age regimen of 0.5 or 2 mg daily. ◊ Reviews. 1. Krattenmacher R.
